user_query: We are planning a Phase 3 randomised controlled trial of a next-generation proteasome inhibitor in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, targeting patients with 2–3 prior lines of therapy including lenalidomide and a prior PI. The trial will be conducted globally across the US, EU, and Asia-Pacific. We are seeking FDA and EMA label claims and will need NICE and ICER submissions. The mechanism involves weekly IV administration with step-up dosing in Cycle 1. Our TPP focuses on improvement in bone pain and physical functioning, but we also need to capture fatigue and treatment tolerability. Please generate a full COA strategy.
answer:
## COA Measurement Strategy — Multiple Myeloma Phase 3

**In one sentence:** Demonstrate that next-generation PI preserves HRQoL and reduces disease-related symptoms compared to standard care while capturing step-up dosing tolerability during Cycle 1.

**Key challenge:** Balancing comprehensive symptom coverage against patient burden in a heavily pre-treated RRMM population with high dropout risk.

**Recommended starting point:** EORTC QLQ-C30 + MY20 + EQ-5D-5L based on strong change detection in TOURMALINE-MM3 and ENDEAVOR [TI-003, TI-005], plus PRO-CTCAE for step-up dosing tolerability [IR-XXX not in KG].

**Critical gap:** No validated instrument in candidate list specifically captures bone pain intensity — BPI-SF typically required for "bone pain improvement" label claims but not in current Domain Coverage Matrix.

## Table 1: Domain Coverage Comparison

| FDA Core Concept | Source | Current Trial Candidates | IKEMA (2021) | TOURMALINE-MM4 (2020) | TOURMALINE-MM3 (2019) | A.R.R.O.W. (2018) | ENDEAVOR (2016) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Disease-related bone pain | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | PRO-CTCAE, BFI, FACT-An | ⚠️ General (QLQ-C30 + MY20, no pain focus) | ⚠️ General (QLQ-C30 + MY20, no pain focus) | QLQ-C30 + MY20 ✅ Change: Y [TI-003] | QLQ-C30 + MY20 ✅ Change: Y [TI-004] | QLQ-C30 + MY20 ✅ Change: Y [TI-005] |
| Physical function | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | PRO-CTCAE, BFI, FACT-An | QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: NR [TI-001] | QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: NR [TI-002] | QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: Y [TI-003] | QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: Y [TI-004] | QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: Y [TI-005] |
| Fatigue | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | PRO-CTCAE, BFI, FACT-An | QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: NR [TI-001] | QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: NR [TI-002] | QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: Y [TI-003] | QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: Y [TI-004] | FACT/GOG-NTX ✅ Change: Y [TI-005] |

## Key Observations

• **EORTC QLQ-C30 + MY20 is the established standard** across all 5 comparator PI trials [TI-001 to TI-005], with significant change detection in 3/5 trials including both ixazomib studies [TI-003, TI-004, TI-005]. This instrument pairing provides regulatory precedent and cross-trial comparability for PI class submissions.

• **PRO-CTCAE gap represents missed opportunity** — no comparator trial used systematic PRO-AE capture despite step-up dosing being standard PI protocol design [TI-001 to TI-005]. FDA's 2021 PRO-CTCAE qualification supports its use for symptomatic AE domains that current candidates cannot address.

• **EQ-5D-5L collection inconsistent** across trials (3/5 collected it) but mandatory for NICE/ICER submissions [IR-007]. TOURMALINE-MM4 and ENDEAVOR omission would preclude UK reimbursement — critical for global launch strategy.

• **Secondary endpoint positioning** dominates landscape (90% of PRO records) with no primary PRO endpoints in MM PI trials [KG positioning data]. This suggests PRO-primary positioning would be novel and high-risk for PI class regulatory strategy.

• **Rejection pattern analysis** shows single-arm bias (8 instances), missing data (4 instances), and hierarchical testing failure (3 instances) as leading PRO rejection reasons [REJ-014 to REJ-050]. Missing data >20% particularly problematic for confirmatory PRO claims [REJ-039].

• **Item library approach unused** in comparator trials — all used full instruments rather than calibrated subscales [TI-001 to TI-005]. This represents 50-88 total items per timepoint, potentially excessive for heavily pre-treated RRMM population with performance status decline.

## Comparator Analysis

| Drug | Mechanism | PRO Instruments | Outcome | Implication |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| carfilzomib | Proteasome Inhibitor | QLQ-C30, MY20, EQ-5D-5L | Significant change (ARROW, ENDEAVOR) | ✅ Strong signal for QLQ-C30 + MY20 in PI class |
| ixazomib | Proteasome Inhibitor | QLQ-C30, MY20 | Significant change (TOURMALINE-MM3) | ✅ Confirms QLQ-C30 sensitivity in oral PI |
| carfilzomib | Proteasome Inhibitor | CSQ-8, QLQ-C30, MY20, EQ-5D-5L | Mixed results (ARROW) | ⚠️ CSQ-8 not regulatory-relevant |

Based on comparator evidence, **EORTC QLQ-C30 + MY20** has the strongest signal of change in PI indication because both carfilzomib and ixazomib trials demonstrated significant improvements using these instruments [TI-003, TI-004, TI-005], establishing instrument sensitivity within proteasome inhibitor class.

## HTA Requirements

| HTA Body | Required Instrument | In candidate list? | Action needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| NICE | EQ-5D-5L | No — missing from Domain Coverage Matrix | **Must add EQ-5D-5L** |
| ICER | EQ-5D-5L | No — missing from Domain Coverage Matrix | **Must add EQ-5D-5L** |

## What the Expert Needs to Decide

1. **Whether to adopt EORTC standard** (QLQ-C30 + MY20 + EQ-5D-5L) based on 5-trial regulatory precedent versus novel PRO-CTCAE approach for symptom-specific capture.

2. **PRO-CTCAE inclusion strategy** for step-up dosing tolerability capture, given no comparator precedent but clear regulatory pathway via FDA qualification.

3. **Secondary endpoint positioning** within testing hierarchy, as 90% precedent suggests PRO-primary would be unprecedented for PI class.

4. **Assessment schedule alignment** with weekly IV dosing and step-up tolerability requirements during Cycle 1.

5. **Bone pain measurement gap** — whether to add BPI-SF for "bone pain improvement" TPP claim, since current candidates lack validated pain intensity scales.
